user.title: Litter box
user.description: Pick the entities your litter box integration exposes. Best: a visit event that carries the weight and duration (UAHPET: *Visit*). Otherwise a visit counter: it detects every visit, even when two in a row report the same weight. The weight sensor must hold the weight of the visit, not the live scale.

data.tolerance: Max difference from a cat's weight

data_description.tolerance: Readings further than this from every cat are logged as unidentified (default 0.5 kg). A lighter reading right after a heavier cat's visit is taken as that cat half inside.
data_description.smoothing: How much each visit moves the learned weight (0 = never, 1 = jump to the reading). It moves towards the median of the latest readings, so one odd reading does not drag it.
data_description.min_weight: Filters out empty-box readings and noise.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify services, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Photos are attached on mobile app targets.
data_description.record_unidentified: Off: readings that don't match any cat are ignored completely (no log, count, event or notification).
data_description.notify_health: Notify when a cat visits much more than usual, stays far longer than usual, or loses 5 % of its weight in three weeks. The *health* binary sensors work either way.

data_description.alert_hours: Hours without a visit before alerting. 0 = off.

live_scale.title: {name}: the weight sensor looks like a live scale
live_scale.description:
Litter Cat Identifier reads the cat's weight from `{entity}`, but that sensor keeps dropping back to about 0 kg. A live scale gives partial weights while the cat leaves, so visits get the wrong cat.

Use a sensor or event with the weight **of each visit**: Litter Cat Identifier → ⋮ → **Reconfigure**. Suggested visit event: `{suggestion}`.
